message.content:
The angles form an arithmetic sequence:

\[
75^\circ, 83^\circ, 91^\circ, \dots, 147^\circ
\]

with common difference \(8^\circ\). There are \(10\) terms.

Write

\[
\text{cis }75^\circ+\text{cis }83^\circ+\cdots+\text{cis }147^\circ
=
\text{cis }75^\circ \sum_{k=0}^{9} \text{cis }(8k^\circ).
\]

Now use the geometric series formula:

\[
\sum_{k=0}^{9} \text{cis }(8k^\circ)
=
\frac{\sin(10\cdot 4^\circ)}{\sin(4^\circ)}
\text{ cis}\left(\frac{9\cdot 8^\circ}{2}\right).
\]

So the angle is shifted by

\[
75^\circ + 36^\circ = 111^\circ.
\]

Since the scalar factor is positive, the argument remains \(111^\circ\).

The answer is \(\boxed{111^\circ}\).
